title: Lion Brewery makes India comeback after 60 years, targets premium beer market
desc: Lion Brewery Co has re-entered the Indian market after more than sixty years. The company is launching its premium beer range in Delhi and plans expansion. This move capitalizes on India's rapidly growing premium beer segment. The brewer partnered with Copperdrop Spirits for distribution across India. This entry aligns with India's broader beer market premiumization trend.

title: Foreign investors return to Indian equities after 4
desc: Foreign portfolio investors FPIs broke a fourmonth selling streak in July by investing ₹20,200 crore in Indian equities. The turnaround follows massive net outflows exceeding ₹2.54 lakh crore earlier in 2026, including a record ₹1.17 lakh crore withdrawn in March alone. Analysts attributed the renewed buying to reasonable valuations, improving corporate earnings and easing global pressures.
